# Rank-three room slay: native positive execution

The earlier natural deployment pair establishes the saved Underlegion champion's
original60ATK/25HP and room-wide+2 propagatable-status payload. The default
Ring6 loss contains champion kills, but its Horde ally dies before those kills;
that record cannot establish a positive status adjustment.

The explicit `-RankThreeRoomSlayExecution` calibration resumes the same Ring6
checkpoint, keeps its champion and upgrades, clears the other opening cards,
and supplies a controlled60ATK/500HP/regen10 steward. It uses complete original
moon and boss capture. Its first launch lacked that capture and failed before
deployment; it is retained outside the curated acceptance pair.

Source133044-eb37f189 and independent process133306-f6740b34 each execute two
deployments and11EndTurns. At native Exchange19/Turn2, champion3 slays enemies
7,8,9 and surviving steward2's regen increases9to15. The room's subsequent
post-combat decay produces14, separately matching the native Room18 result.
Each process passes109 raw room/exchange stages,22 train phases, both actions,
all11 full EndTurns and four zero failure counters. Original files are unchanged.

The focused checker preserves full successor/context/RNG equality, four
immutable exchange branches and four complete model-owned deployment/battle
chains, then compares both processes' complete action/EndTurn states. The
earlier natural deployment pair and six unknown-payload guards remain intact.
This closes positive execution for the captured+2 signature with regen; it does
not establish every possible propagatable status combination. Both controlled
battles end in defeat and are never counted as random campaign victories.
